title: Generative Websites authoring configuration v1
description: Structural reference schema for the value of generative-websites metadata, not an entire Quarto document or the catalog/route-file formats.
$comment: Copyright 2026 Kai Prince. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. This schema adds no automatic Quarto editor integration. Validate JSON-compatible metadata values; Quarto's MetaMap/MetaList conversion and effective metadata layering are separate. Runtime additionally enforces at most 512 prerequisite expression nodes across the page configuration and depth 16, UTF-8 byte/text rules, page binding, reviewed-object availability, compatible contexts and route limits. Reference-schema validation does not establish those checks or pedagogical correctness.

then.$comment: Explicit enabled: false bypasses all other stale options, including malformed prerequisites and unknown keys, exactly as the runtime's deactivation path does.

identifier.description: Native object/reference ID: ASCII letter first, at most 128 ASCII characters; constructor and prototype are reserved.
